removed.title: Islam Makhachev defends Usman Nurmagomedov, condemns Merab Dvalishvili’s past behavior

image.alt: Article image: Islam Makhachev defends Usman Nurmagomedov, condemns Merab Dvalishvili’s past behavior

summaryPoints: Islam Makhachev has Usman Nurmagomedov’s back after video surfaced on Wednesday that showed him attacking Merab Dvalishvili at the RAF event happening in Abu Dhabi.
The bad blood between the Nurmagomedov family and Dvalishvili has been well documented but Usman’s attack has been heavily criticized after multiple videos surfaced from the altercation.
In the video, Usman is seen approaching Dvalishvili during an interview and then almost immediately slapping him, which sets off a chaotic scene between the fighters and their friends.

perry.title: Mike Perry re-signs with UFC
summaryPoints: Mike Perry is returning to the UFC octagon.
“Platinum” officially announced that he’s re-signed with the UFC on Friday.
Perry hasn’t competed for the promotion since losing a unanimous decision to Daniel Rodriguez at UFC Vegas 23 in April 2021.
